findings.text: the assertion compares node_budget against FENCE, the same constant the test passes into config, so any implementation that echoes the configured fence satisfies it; the independent guard is the over_60m bucket assertion at line 85.
the regex hardcodes betelgeuse and all_debug, duplicating reckon/nested_launch.py:76 PARTITION_EXAMPLES, so a partition added to that owner never reaches the picker floor.

partition and gpu match ordinary prose such as partitioning a table, so a non-compute node can be reported at the full fence; the floor is a lower bound so the cost is an overstated size, not a shortened budget.
